title: Origin story: Thornbrand
description: Thornbrand was a hedge-knight who defended the briar villages with a sword of blackthorn, and when the raiders came with torches, he set the briars alight himself — a controlled burn that trapped the raiders and spared the villages. He wields fire and thorn together now, the guardian of the burning hedge.
